newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OPTICS STORAGE SHIPS VENTURE NOVASTATION.
newsitem.headline: OPTICS STORAGE SHIPS VENTURE NOVASTATION.

text.p: Optics Storage Pte Ltd said on Friday it was shipping CD-ROM drives with Venture Manufacturing's new multimedia software, NovaStation.
The software, developed by Venture's unit Innovative Trek Technology Pte Ltd (ITT), upgrades existing 16-bit compatible sound cards.
In the form of a CD-ROM, NovaStation allows 128 voices to be played and is designed to run on Windows 95, Pentium or MMX-based personal computers.
Optics Storage makes optical storage products and CD-ROM drives. It is the first original equipment manufacturer (OEM) to announce it is bundling its products with Novastation.
ITT said at the launch of NovaStation it was targetting the software at the OEM market.
